answer.reason: Honduras' female population share in 2023 would be close to half of the total population, around 49.65%. A value of 53.27% is implausibly high for Honduras.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Population, female (% of total population)', what value is listed for Honduras (HND) in 2023?

A. 53.2727603125568%
B. 49.6498353992931%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Population, female (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL.FE.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)

Supplied draft answer: A
